summary: Diff implements plan-context passing into the bank transfer dialog and adds WhatsApp URL support for a bank-transfer confirmation message. Some REQ-20/REQ-21 acceptance criteria (numbered instructions, per-field copy behavior, and conditional display of WhatsApp CTA based on plan selection) are not fully verifiable from the provided truncated diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Dialog includes a concise numbered instruction list in English for completing a bank transfer and confirming payment.
missing_requirements.reason: The truncated dialog diff shows only the header/description and start of the order summary. No numbered instruction list is visible in the provided snippet, so it cannot be confirmed as implemented.

missing_requirements.requirement: Existing per-field copy buttons continue to work (or are replaced only if the new experience is clearly better and still provides copy capability for all fields).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows new shared copy helpers and a bulk "copyAllDetails" function, but the truncated content does not show the actual per-field copy UI, so it cannot be confirmed that per-field copy remains available for all fields.

missing_requirements.requirement: WhatsApp confirmation CTA is only shown when bank details are available and a plan has been selected via “Pay via Bank Transfer”.
missing_requirements.reason: The component gates the entire dialog content on `bankDetails` (early return when absent), but the snippet does not show the WhatsApp CTA rendering and whether it is also gated on `planSummary` being present.
